build_target_assigner: build an AxisAlignedTargetAssigner instance with model config, class names, and box coder for 3D anchor target assignment
assign_targets_batch: assign classification labels and regression targets to anchors across a batch of ground truth 3D boxes
assign_targets_single: assign targets to anchors for a single sample using IoU thresholds and optional foreground sampling
review_match_height: review the AxisAlignedTargetAssigner match_height flag to toggle between 3D IoU and BEV nearest IoU matching
refactor_multihead: refactor the AxisAlignedTargetAssigner to enable or disable multihead and separate multihead RPN configurations
